# Plan: Deploy the game to GitHub Pages

## Design

Add `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, triggered on push to `main` and `workflow_dispatch`.

- `build` job: `contents: read`. Checkout without persisted credentials, set up Node 24.22.0 with the same pinned action SHAs as `browser-tests.yml`, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, upload `dist` with `actions/upload-pages-artifact`.
- `deploy` job: needs `build`, with only `pages: write` and `id-token: write`, in the `github-pages` environment, using `actions/deploy-pages`.
- `concurrency: pages` with `cancel-in-progress: false`, so a running deployment finishes.

Deployment prerequisite, outside this change: the maintainer enabled Pages with `POST repos/supernovae/signal-lost/pages build_type=workflow`, which returned `https://supernovae.github.io/signal-lost/`. It cannot be observed from the sandbox, so it is treated as unverified until the post-merge observation. No secret or token is added, and nothing reaches the client bundle.

Export `SITE_BASE` from a new `site.config.ts` (default `/signal-lost/`, still overridable by `SIGNAL_LOST_BASE`), and import it in `vite.config.ts`. Add `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`:

- reads the Vite base and asserts `/signal-lost/`;
- runs `vite build` to a temporary directory with the project config and asserts `index.html` references its script under `/signal-lost/assets/`.

## Files

- New: `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `site.config.ts`, `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`
- Changed: `vite.config.ts`, and `tsconfig.json` only if the new root file is not already included (`*.ts` already covers it)

## Edge cases

- A failed build must not deploy: `deploy` needs `build`.
- The test build must not touch `dist/`, because other checks may use it.

## Out of scope

The custom 404 page and post-deploy smoke verification, which belong to the release WorkUnit.

# Test plan

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow builds with `npm ci` and `npm run build`, and deploys `dist` on push to main and manual dispatch | `npx prettier --check .github/workflows/pages.yml` checks YAML parsing and formatting only. Actions semantics are checked by source inspection of: both triggers, both npm commands, the `dist` artifact path, `deploy` needing `build`, the `github-pages` environment, and each job's permissions. | Developer runs; tester inspects independently |
| Built `index.html` references assets under `/signal-lost/` | `npx vitest run tests/unit/pages.test.ts` reads the Vite base and inspects a temporary build. | Developer runs; tester reuses a passing result |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the commands above and `npm run lint`.
- **Tester:** independently inspects the workflow and acceptance coverage, reuses applicable passing developer results, and repeats a check only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.

## Post-merge observations (not sandbox validation gates)

The `main` Pages run succeeds and `https://supernovae.github.io/signal-lost/` returns 200.

VERDICT: APPROVED

| Contract item | Audit |
| --- | --- |
| Publish main and manual builds to Pages | Plan specifies both triggers, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, a `dist` Pages artifact, and deployment dependent on the build. Test plan includes independent workflow inspection. |
| Verify project subpath in built HTML | Planned unit test reads the actual Vite base and checks the script URL in a temporary production build under `/signal-lost/assets/`. |
| Scope and protected files | Adds only the Pages workflow among workflows; leaves `swarm-validate.yml` and `browser-tests.yml` unchanged. Small configuration extraction and unit test support the explicit second acceptance criterion. Harness changes are authorized. |
| Least privilege and credentials | Build has `contents: read`; deploy has only `pages: write` and `id-token: write`. Checkout disables persisted credentials; no client token is proposed. |
| Evidence and conventions | Existing `vite.config.ts` confirms the default base and environment override. `tsconfig.json` includes `*.ts`. `browser-tests.yml` confirms the cited checkout/setup-node pins and Node version. No dependencies or game content changes are proposed. |
| Validation ownership and sandbox | Focused developer checks and independent tester inspection/reuse follow policy. Coordinator owns complete required validation. No browser launch, server, or network observation blocks sandbox implementation. |

Read `REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md`; it contains the prior design and test plan, with no additional reports or unmerged lessons. The claimed Pages enablement cannot be verified from repository evidence and is explicitly treated as unverified pending the post-merge observation. This is not evidence of a successful deployment.

No required revisions. This verdict approves the proposed plan; implementation and deployment results remain to be verified.
